format: C++/C++-style source file with PyBind11 bindings
description: This source file initializes Python bindings for the Torch JIT (Just-In-Time compilation) subsystem, exposing various functions, classes, and utilities related to JIT compilation, graph manipulation, serialization, and backend extension. It includes registration of exception translation, binding for classes such as Graph, Module, Code, etc., and many functions for graph transformations, optimizations, profiling, and hardware-specific passes.

classes.name: c10::SymNode
classes.description: Wrapper class for symbolic nodes used in shape analysis and symbolic computations.

classes.name: CompleteArgumentSpec
classes.description: Represents a complete argument specification used during shape inference.

classes.name: ArgumentSpec
classes.description: Represents argument specifications, possibly partial, for graph inputs.

classes.name: Code
classes.description: Holds compiled code and associated metadata for JIT-compiled graphs.

classes.name: ExecutionPlan
classes.description: Encapsulates a JIT execution plan including its graph and code.

classes.name: Gradient
classes.description: Stores gradient information related to backward pass of autograd.

classes.name: GraphExecutorState
classes.description: Holds the state of a graph executor including its associated graph and fallback info.

classes.name: PyTorchStreamWriter
classes.description: Provides functionality to write serialized data streams for model saving.

classes.name: PyTorchStreamReader
classes.description: Provides reading capabilities for serialized model files and records.
